family: low-nibble-3 compact MOVE / zero-extend / address-prep family (byte0 0x03..0xf3; high nibble = destination register). Provoked with OWN-MSL (EXP-M4-13). Clean-room: field positions from byte-diffing our own compiled zero-extend/move shaders; NO Apple binary inspected; NO GPU dispatch (compile+extract+tokenize+byte-diff only).

lengthRules.lengthBitNote: op-select in byte+2 (0x27) marks the WIDE address/coordinate/matrix-load-prep form. dst = byte0 high nibble.

PRE-EXISTING (EXP-M4-12 S1): the SFU sin/cos range-reduction 2-byte immediate/coefficient WORD. This is operand DATA, not an opcode; left undescribed on purpose (clean-room rule 5 forbids reconstructing the range-reduction sequence). Checked BEFORE the generic low-nibble-3 rule so it is preserved.
PRE-EXISTING (EXP-0029): fragment sample-id / sample-position read. Checked before the generic rule.

lengthRules.applyWhen: byte0 low-nibble == 0x3 (fall-through: not the byte+2==0x27 / byte+2==0x26 / 0x03-byte+1==0x02 cases above)
lengthRules.lengthBitNote: The generic compact MOVE / 16-bit zero-extend / half-pack. The FIX vs the committed DB is that byte0==0x03 (dst r0) now takes this rule too -- the committed rule had `and b0 != 0x03`, which desynced every dst-r0 form. dst = byte0 high nibble (r0..r15). The committed 4/10 split for high-nibbles 0x13..0xf3 was already correct and is preserved.

opSelectMap.note: Within low-nibble-3 the operation is selected by LENGTH + the byte+2 op-select, not by a bit inside one word. dst is ALWAYS byte0 high nibble.
opSelectMap.4-byte (byte+2 not 0x27): n3_mov  (compact register move / uint->ushort->uint zero-extend / half-pack). byte+2 sub-form: 0x00 = word/high-half-zero companion (the ubiquitous `X3 00 00 01`); 0x01/0x09 = low-half move.
opSelectMap.2-byte byte0==0x03 byte+1==0x02: SFU range-reduction operand WORD (DATA, not an opcode -- intentionally not described)

descriptors.semantics: d = mov/zero-extend(srcA) ; compact 4-byte register move / 16-bit zero-extend / half-pack. dst = byte0 high nibble (r0..r15). byte1 = source operand (bit7 = uniform-file/high-half flag). byte2 selects the sub-form (word vs low-half move); a 32-bit zero-extend of a 16-bit value emits the low-half move followed by the `X3 00 00 01` high-half-zero companion.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 (dst PROVEN by parallel-extend & uint4 diffs -- k_zext4/k_zext8w emit identical bodies differing only in the high nibble; srcA=byte1 tracks the source reg by +1 increment, src=dst+4 in k_zext4; sel/srcB semantics INFERRED from OWN-MSL zero-extend/move constructs -- NOT hardware dispatch-validated). Generalises the HW-validated mov_zext16 (byte0 0x13, dst r1). Less specific (4 match bits) so mov_zext16/frame_marker keep byte0 0x13/0x43.

descriptors.semantics: d = address/coordinate prep (matrix-load / texture-address / coordinate ALU). 10-byte low-nibble-3 form, op-select byte+2==0x27. dst = byte0 high nibble.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 (length + op-select established across all dst high nibbles in the corpus; dst = high nibble by family analogy; operand body kept structural/raw -- NOT hardware dispatch-validated). Distinct from the low-nibble-2 rt_transform_test (also byte+2==0x27).

descriptors.semantics: fragment sample-id / sample-position read (byte0 0x03, op-select byte+2==0x26). 10-byte low-nibble-3 form.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 (length/op-select from the EXP-0029 fragment sample-read length rule; body structural/raw -- NOT hardware dispatch-validated).

notes: High-nibble-of-byte0 = destination register was PROVEN (not just assumed) for this family: four parallel independent zero-extends (k_zext8w) and a uint4 write (k_zext4) emit identical operand bodies that differ ONLY in the high nibble, stepping r0,r1,r2,r3,... The committed DB already lengthed high-nibbles 0x13..0xf3 correctly but (a) had NO descriptor for dst != r1 (0x13) -- 659 family-only gaps -- and (b) EXCLUDED byte0==0x03 from the length rule -- 155 desync gaps. This proposal adds the generic n3_mov/n3_addr_prep descriptors (naming all dst regs) and drops the `and b0 != 0x03` exclusion so dst-r0 forms length as 4/10 and resync. mov_zext16 (0x13) and frame_marker (0x43) are left untouched (they win on match-bit specificity). The 4-byte form's dst is 4 bits (addresses r0..r15 only); a wider destination presumably uses the 10-byte or another form -- noted as a follow-up.
provenance: OWN-SHADER byte-diff (EXP-M4-13). Field positions from our own compiled MSL (corpus/dec_n3_three/*.metal -> hex/dec_n3_three/*.hex). No Apple binary was disassembled or introspected. No GPU dispatch: compile + extract + tokenize + byte-diff only. dst is byte-diff-PROVEN; source/sub-form fields are byte-diff-INFERRED (not HW-splice-validated).

validation.method: Scratch copy work/scratch_n3three/isadb.py (committed DB + this proposal's length change + 3 descriptors). (a) All 736 corpus hex files walked: low-nibble-3 tokens = 2653 NAMED (n3_mov 2216, mov_zext16 232, frame_marker 166, n3_addr_prep 36, n3_sample_read 3), 0 DESYNC landing on a low-nibble-3 byte0 (was 155), 99 remaining unnamed = the 2-byte `03 02` SFU words (data, intentionally not an opcode). (b) 869/870 distinct low-nibble-3 op byte-strings decode_one() cleanly AND assemble(disasm(b))==b; the 1 non-decoding string is `0302`, the 2-byte SFU word (correctly no descriptor). (c) roundtrip_test.py against the scratch DB = ALL PASS (no regression to other families). (d) Global corpus desync steps 11903 -> 11087 (-816), files fully clean 377 -> 383 (+6); no family regressed. (e) All 12 OWN-SHADER probe shaders tokenize 100% clean, including the previously-desyncing dst-r0 `03 00 00 01` forms.

unresolved: 2-byte `03 02` SFU range-reduction WORD (99 instances): lengthed (=2) by the pre-existing EXP-M4-12 rule and left WITHOUT an instruction descriptor on purpose -- it is range-reduction operand DATA, and clean-room rule 5 forbids reconstructing that sequence. It is byte0==0x03 (in this owned low-nibble) but is not an opcode.

BOUNDARY: a genuine dst-r0 move with byte+1==0x02 (analogous to the 0x13 b1==0x02 forms that DO exist in-corpus) would be mis-lengthed as the 2-byte `03 02` SFU word by the pre-existing rule. Not resolved here to avoid regressing the validated EXP-M4-12 SFU rule; no such collision was observed in the corpus (all `03 02` occur in transcendental range-reduction contexts).

n3_mov sub-form (byte2) and second-operand (byte3) semantics are INFERRED from own-MSL constructs, not HW-splice-validated. The 4-byte form's destination field is only 4 bits (r0..r15); whether a wider dst exists (bits spilling into byte1) is uncharacterised. n3_addr_prep / n3_sample_read operand bodies are structural/raw (length + op-select established; full operand decomposition is a follow-up).
